title: Underdetermined Peer Merge
summary: Two monitored paths merge into a 70 Mbps uplink. Only their sum and one downstream reading are known.
concept: Two independent equations for three unknowns cannot identify a unique split. Rank tells us how much information the measurements actually contain.

variables.meaning: Traffic from B to the uplink (Mbps)

teachingNotes: The coefficient matrix has rank 2 while there are 3 unknowns, so one variable remains free.
Writing x₃ = t gives x₂ = 50 − t and x₁ = 20 + t; every t produces a valid traffic split.
One more independent measurement is needed before a single distribution can be reported.
